# player_feature_screen_v1 — screening report

*Generated by feature_lab.py; runtime 552s; 200 permutations per test; ridge lambda=1.0 on standardized inputs.*

## Protocol (as registered; deviations documented below)

- Screening window 2021-2024 ONLY; quarantine asserted on every matrix (`quarantine_audit.json`, all-pass=True, 8 matrices).
- Targets: per-36 channel production (fg3=3*fg3m, paint=points_paint, ft=ftm, np2=pts-3*fg3m-ftm-points_paint) on played RS rows, minutes>=8, >=5 prior same-season appearances. Robustness rerun at minutes>=15.
- Baseline: shifted per-player ratio-EWMA rate (EWMA(channel pts)/EWMA(minutes)*36), alpha tuned per channel on the 3 inner walk-forward folds of 2021-2023 (evalharness.inner_tuning_splits), frozen: {'fg3': np.float64(0.05), 'paint': np.float64(0.05), 'ft': np.float64(0.05), 'np2': np.float64(0.05)}.
- Candidate model: ridge [baseline, feature] fit 2021-2023, scored 2024. delta = MAE(ridge[b,f]) - MAE(ridge[b]) — the ridge-recalibrated baseline is the reference, so the delta isolates the feature's marginal information; the raw-EWMA baseline MAE is reported below and the permutation null uses the identical statistic.
- EWMA-carrying features sweep alpha {0.05..0.50 step 0.05} on inner folds only, frozen per channel before 2024 is touched (#92 sweeps its blend weight 0.1..0.9 through the same engine).
- Null: 200 within-season permutations of the FEATURE VALUES on train AND validation, refit, rescore. Permuting the feature leaves the (baseline, target) pairing untouched — the baseline's information is fully preserved — while destroying the feature's alignment with specific player-games; within-season blocks keep each season's marginal feature distribution, so season-level shifts earn no credit. p = (1 + #{null >= obs}) / (1 + n_perm) (add-one correction).
- Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 10% across all 256 (candidate x channel) tests; survival additionally requires sign-consistent improvement (all 3 inner folds AND 2024 negative delta).

## Interpretation decisions (pinned before results were seen)

- **Delta reference**: ridge-recalibrated baseline (see Protocol). Both reference MAEs are reported; the null uses the same statistic, so the p-values are internally consistent.
- **interaction_with_baseline**: the catalog defines no explicit baseline interactions — every 'x' in a catalog sketch is built INSIDE the feature. The mechanism exists in the harness but is False for all 81 candidates.
- **Schedule facts** (venue, rest, tip hour, refs, opponent identity, trip position) attach unshifted — they are known pre-tip. Every performance trend is shifted within (player_id, season).
- **Cross-season candidates** (#19, 71, 77, 78, 87, 88, 89, 92) use strictly-prior information across seasons — the honest reading of 'features reset per season' for the cross-season identity family.
- **Feature NaNs** are mean-filled with FIT-window means at fit time (inner-fold fills use fold-train means); this is feature encoding, not raw-data imputation.
- **Known limitation**: row-exchangeable permutation understates within-player clustering of slow-moving features (#87/#92 style); their p-values are honest against the registered null but the confirmation experiment on 2025-2026 is the real gate.

## Deviations and skips

- **Skipped**: 20 (production_vs_specific_defender): requires a shot-event x stint-window x specific-defender join; every tractable reduction duplicates #14 (rim protection) or #57 (competition quality); deferred to a dedicated build if the lineup family shows life
- #10 tip times from PBP wall clock (odds commence times only exist in the quarantined era).
- #49/#56 use game-level star splits / team-ppp pair lift (player-level production attribution inside stint windows is not derivable from public data).
- #54 is a context share (possessions alongside >=3 own starters), not a production split, for the same attribution reason.
- Opponent/team/ref context EWMAs are fixed at alpha=0.10 (constitution rule 3 constant); the sweep applies to the candidate's own core player-trend EWMA.
- #6/#10/#12/#16 'pooled then personalized' profiles are personalized-only (shrunk to zero): a train-window pooled constant would leak across inner folds.
- Permutation p-values use the add-one correction (never exactly 0).

None.

## Files

- `survivor_summary.csv` — survivors only (+ min15 robustness)
- `robustness_min15.csv` — full >=15-minute rerun (frozen alphas)
- `alpha_curves.csv`, `baseline_alpha_curves.csv` — inner-fold sweeps
- `diagnostics/top20_diagnostics.csv` — null quantiles for the top 20
- `quarantine_audit.json` — per-matrix date audit
